purpose: Provenance for every Architecture Guardian rule. A rule with no incident record is rejected at load — see scripts/architecture-guardian.js. This file is the evidence, the guardian is the enforcement.
principle: Rules must never exist because they sound like good practice. Every rule below traces to a defect that actually occurred in this repository, with the commit that fixed it.

precisionPolicy.rationale: A rule that cries wolf gets muted, and a muted rule protects nothing. Every rule records what its first run reported versus what survived scrutiny. A rule whose precision falls below 0.5 is marked NOISY and must be refined before it may block a deploy.

RULE-001.title: No hardcoded identity in an authorisation comparison
RULE-001.rootCause: bootstrapAdminClaim compared request.auth.token.email against an address hardcoded in functions/index.js. Phone sign-in carries no email claim, so the comparison failed for every phone-authenticated user regardless of which address was configured.
RULE-001.impact: The platform owner could not become an administrator. No moderation, refunds, user management or incident response was possible on the live platform.
RULE-001.resolution: 8f38864 — authorisation moved to a UID allowlist in _systemConfig/bootstrap, seeded out of band
RULE-001.expectedLifetime: permanent — an identity in source is never a valid authorisation gate

precision.refinedTo: a COMPARISON against an identity from the auth token, not the mere presence of one
precision.falsePositivesWere: PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAIL (a notification recipient), a console help string, two adminWA WhatsApp contact numbers
precision.note: Precision is unmeasured until the rule fires again on real code. Zero findings is not evidence of accuracy.

RULE-002.title: Search write index equals read index
RULE-002.rootCause: functions/algolia-indexer.js mapped products to `products_index`; the live search engine, the server search service and the sync registry all read `sokoni_products`.
RULE-002.impact: Every product indexed since the mapping was introduced was written to an index no query touches. Merchants uploaded goods that no customer could find. No error was raised at any layer.
RULE-002.resolution: a5201c0 — write target changed to sokoni_products
RULE-002.expectedLifetime: permanent — a write/read target divergence is silent by construction

RULE-003.title: No authorisation guard on a claim nothing sets
RULE-003.rootCause: Eleven modules guarded on token.isAdmin / token.isSuperAdmin. The only admin claims this codebase writes are `admin` and role-keyed entries; no isAdmin claim is set anywhere.
RULE-003.impact: 24 guards evaluated false for every caller including real administrators, returning a correct-looking permission-denied. The affected Cloud Functions were inaccessible to everyone.
RULE-003.evidence: functions/ade.js:33, business-metrics.js:16, etims.js:944, hub-etims.js:432 and 20 others

precision.refinedTo: privilege-denoting claim names only, with hedging sought in a surrounding window rather than one line
precision.falsePositivesWere: isPartial (a queue flag), isSeller, and post-launch-monitor.js which hedges on t.admin three lines below inside a multi-line boolean

RULE-004.title: Product writes carry every field the read path filters on
RULE-004.rootCause: seller.js wrote ownership.status and verificationStatus but no top-level `status`, while every retrieval path filters where('status','==','active'). A Firestore equality filter never matches a document where the field is absent.
RULE-004.impact: Uploaded products were excluded from search before ranking. Compounded INC-2026-07-20-B; either alone made a product invisible.
RULE-004.resolution: a5201c0 — status:'active' added to the upload payload
RULE-004.expectedLifetime: until the product schema is centrally validated at write time

RULE-005.title: Navigation targets resolve to a real page
RULE-005.rootCause: Nothing could address a section of seller.html — the router hardcoded 'overview' regardless of URL — so other pages linked to filenames they wished existed.
RULE-005.impact: 18 dead links, including three of the four items in seller-earnings.html's bottom nav, and seven Profile controls.
RULE-005.resolution: 9b3498b — 24 links repaired, hash router added to seller.js

precision.refinedTo: runtime-built hrefs (template literals, string concatenation) treated as unresolvable rather than dead
precision.falsePositivesWere: ${BASE}, '+r.href+' and similar placeholders inside JS that emits markup
precision.note: 0.23 at first run. After refinement the rule reports 0 on a repository where all 18 are fixed; precision will be re-measured when it next fires.

RULE-006.title: Every page is registered in navigation-registry.json
RULE-006.rootCause: Explore, breadcrumbs, global search and KASS routing all derive from the registry. A page absent from it is invisible to every one of them.
RULE-006.impact: 125 pages unreachable from anywhere; 9 with no exit at all.

RULE-007.title: A catch must not blame the network without reading the error
RULE-007.rootCause: pos-setup.html caught bootstrapDevice's failure, discarded the error object entirely, and printed 'check your connection' — the one cause it could not be, since the application had just loaded over that connection.
RULE-007.impact: POS provisioning failures were undiagnosable from the device. Identifying a permission-denied required a full trace through the provisioning pipeline.
RULE-007.resolution: 74138b7 — _provDiagnose maps the error code to an actionable cause

precision.refinedTo: only catches whose message blames the connection, rather than any catch that shows a message without reading the error
precision.falsePositivesWere: generic 'could not load, try again' messages, which are a fair thing to show
precision.note: All 7 survivors verified by reading the code they point at. Two are in pos-setup.html itself, in the business-loading path missed by the original fix.

RULE-008.title: Page-entrance keyframes end at transform:none
RULE-008.rootCause: sk-page-in ended at translateY(0) with animation-fill-mode:both, leaving an identity matrix permanently. Any non-none transform makes an element the containing block for its position:fixed descendants.
RULE-008.impact: banking.html's bottom nav sat at y=1157 on a 664px viewport — off-screen, unreachable, and indistinguishable from a nav whose buttons do not work. Two pages affected.
RULE-008.resolution: 3eb36bc — keyframes end at transform:none; animation removed from the two affected wrappers
RULE-008.expectedLifetime: permanent — this is a CSS specification behaviour, not a browser bug

RULE-009.title: No credentials inside the repository
RULE-009.rootCause: No incident. This is the single preventive rule in the set, admitted because the failure is irreversible: removing a committed key does not remove it from git history, and the key is a full-project credential.
RULE-009.impact: None observed. functions/scripts/typesense-direct.js:10 documents a key path that once existed and has since been correctly deleted.
RULE-009.policyException: Admitted without an incident record because the cost of the first occurrence is unbounded and unrecoverable. Recorded explicitly so the exception is visible rather than silent.

RULE-010.title: Repository is not ahead of its remote
RULE-010.rootCause: An entire engineering cycle of repairs was committed locally and never pushed.
RULE-010.impact: 212 commits existed only on one workstation while production ran the unrepaired code. A launch on that day would have shipped every defect the cycle had just fixed. This was the decisive finding of the launch readiness review.
RULE-010.resolution: unresolved — the gate blocks until the commits are pushed

notMeasured: Runtime drift detection (repository vs deployment vs observed behaviour) requires an authenticated session against the live project. Not implemented rather than approximated.
Change impact / blast radius prediction requires a call graph this codebase does not expose. Not implemented rather than guessed.
Developer override tracking and average investigation time need a history of real usage. The precision figures above are the only measured data available.
